remarks: Welcome to 10 Sable Street, a delightful Cape nestled in Harbor Shore-an up-and-coming coastal enclave just minutes from vibrant SoNo and the village charm of Rowayton. This move-in ready home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and a perfect balance of character, comfort, and modern updates, plus Rowayton Schools.   Inside, you'll find an open-concept kitchen featuring warm maple countertops, a tumbled marble backsplash, and recessed lighting that flows effortlessly into a spacious front-to-back living room. Anchored by a cozy propane stove, the living space opens to a brand-new Trex deck-an inviting extension of the home that leads directly to the true showstopper: the backyard.  The private, lush backyard is a rare find-fully fenced and beautifully landscaped with mature trees, blooming hydrangeas, and a dedicated pergola lounge area, ideal for summer evenings or peaceful mornings. With a level lawn, full irrigation system, and plenty of space to relax or entertain, this outdoor retreat feels like your own secret garden.  Upstairs, all three bedrooms offer thoughtful storage, with oversized closets in the primary and second bedrooms, custom built-ins in the third, and a ceiling fan in the primary for year-round comfort. The upstairs bath features a jetted soaking tub, while the main level includes a second full bath with a walk-in shower.
